label: py_gsva
method: GSVA::gsva(method='gsva', kcdf='Poisson', min.sz=5, max.sz=500) numpy port (old-API matrix semantics at GSVA 1.50.x)
impl_route: pure numpy/scipy: .filterFeatures (per-gene sample sd ddof=1, sd<1e-10 -> 0, drop sd==0/NaN genes, method!='ssgsea') -> .mapGeneSetsToFeatures (match to rownames, first occurrence, NA dropped per set) -> filterGeneSets(max(1,min.sz)..max.sz on mapped sizes) -> kcdf='Poisson' => rnaseq=TRUE, kernel=TRUE -> compute.gene.density via Poisson kernel: F_gt = (1/S) sum_s ppois(x_gt, x_gs + 0.5) with bw=0.5 (kernel_estimation.c row_d verbatim), z = -log((1-F)/F) -> per-sample order(z, decreasing) -> rank scores w(rank r) = |n - r + 1 - n/2| (compute_rank_score verbatim) -> KS random walk per set per sample (ks_test.c ks_sample verbatim): hit += w^tau / sum_gset w^tau, miss -= 1/(n - |Gamma|), mx_pos = max(0, max cum), mx_neg = min(0, min cum), mx.diff=TRUE: ES = mx_pos + mx_neg (abs.ranking=TRUE: mx_pos - mx_neg; mx.diff=FALSE: (mx_pos > |mx_neg|) ? mx_pos : mx_neg); Rmath ppois(q, lam) = P(Pois(lam) <= q) implemented as scipy.special.gammaincc(floor(q+1e-7)+1, lam) [integer identity P(Pois(lam)<=k) = Q(k+1, lam)], q<0 -> 0; vectorization: gene-chunked pairwise kernel (S_t x S_s per gene), sample-loop with set-dimension fully vectorized membership matrix (no per-set python loop)
parity_mode: numeric_port vs GSVA 1.50.5 R reference (to be produced by the campaign bench): protocol = spearman(ES flat) >= 0.95 AND top-k set-sample pairs overlap >= 70% => PASS; additionally the naive C-source transcription cross-check (smoke U1/U3) anchors the kernel and KS-walk to 0.0 deviation pre-R
entry_point: run_gsva(expr: DataFrame genes x cells, gene_sets: dict name -> [gene names], min_sz=5, max_sz=500, tau=1.0, mx_diff=True, abs_ranking=False, verbose=False) -> DataFrame sets x cells (= R gsva() return)
semantics_implemented: old API gsva(expr=, gset.idx.list=, method='gsva', kcdf='Poisson', min.sz=5, max.sz=500) at GSVA 1.50.5 (Bioconductor 3.18): kcdf='Poisson' => rnaseq=TRUE, kernel=TRUE (R/gsva.R setMethod matrix,list verbatim)
.filterFeatures: genes with constant expression (sample sd < 1e-10 -> 0) dropped with the R-side warning reproduced as a verbose note; < 2 genes -> error
gene-set mapping to rownames with match() first-occurrence semantics; unmatched genes dropped per set; size filter on MAPPED sizes with min.sz clamped to >= 1
Poisson kernel ECDF: F_gt = (1/S) sum_s ppois(x_gt, x_gs + 0.5); z_gt = -log((1-F)/F); F=1 in float64 -> z=+inf reproduced identically to the C source (no clipping)
Rmath ppois floor tolerance 1e-7 replicated exactly: k = floor(q + 1e-7); P = gammaincc(k+1, lam)

rank scores: per sample, genes ordered by z decreasing; rank r gene (1-based, highest z first) gets |n - r + 1 - n/2| (top gene gets n/2, bottom |n/2 - 1|, middle 0 for even n) - compute_rank_score verbatim, consistent with paper eq. r_ij = |p/2 - rank|
KS walk weights: hits w^tau / sum_{g in set} w^tau; misses -1/(n - |set|); cumsum sequential over rank order (np.cumsum axis=1 == C sequential accumulation); tau=1 default => pow(w, 1.0) == w

ES combination: mx.diff=TRUE (default) => mx_pos + mx_neg (signed difference of the two extreme deviations; paper eq.5 with ES- as magnitude); abs.ranking=TRUE => mx_pos - mx_neg (Kuiper form); mx.diff=FALSE => (mx_pos > |mx_neg|) ? mx_pos : mx_neg
output orientation sets x cells with set names as index, cell names as columns (= R es.obs matrix)
uncertainties: PPois IMPLEMENTATION ROUTE: R's ppois (Rmath -> pgamma path with floor(q+1e-7)) is here scipy.special.gammaincc(k+1, lam); both compute the same regularized upper incomplete gamma but via different algorithms (cephes vs Rmath) -> last-ULP differences possible in F, propagating to z. Rank-parity protocol absorbs this; expected ES deviations ~1e-12.

ECDF MEAN: C accumulates left_tail sequentially over density samples then divides; numpy F.mean(axis=1) uses pairwise summation -> last-ULP difference in F (~1e-16 relative), same absorption argument.

TIE ORDER IN RANKS: R apply(order, decreasing=TRUE) on doubles uses shell sort (unstable); we use argsort(kind='stable'). For count data with exactly equal z values within a sample the gene order among ties (and hence the walk increments order) may differ from R -> ES deviations bounded by the tie-block width effect. Observed z ties are rare (continuous kernel); flagged for the parity protocol.
SUM_GSET REDUCTION: C sums w^tau over the gene set sequentially in gset_idxs order; we compute memberships @ w (BLAS reduction order differs) -> last-ULP differences; same absorption.

KCDF GAUSSIAN / 'none' AND ssgsea/zscore/plage NOT PORTED: metaTF only calls method='gsva', kcdf='Poisson' (ISSUE-FACTS/code-anatomy.md section 5(d)); Gaussian kernel branch in C additionally uses a 10001-entry precomputed table lookup (kernel_estimation.c) which we chose not to replicate.

OLD-API ONLY: the new gsvaPar S4 API (GSVA >= 1.50 new interface) has slightly different filtering entry points (.filterFeatures_newAPI); metaTF uses the deprecated expr/gset.idx.list names (code-anatomy note on version coupling) - we port the deprecated-method chain that metaTF actually hits.
PARALLEL PATH NOT PORTED: parallel.sz>1 splits compute.gene.density by gene chunks across workers; numerically identical results, we always run serial.
EMPTY/WARN PATHS: R warns 'Some gene sets have size one' when mapped sets of size 1 survive (min.sz=5 here filters them anyway); not reproduced.

ES BOUNDARY: sets whose sum_gset == 0 (all member genes at the exact middle rank with even n... impossible for size >= 2 distinct genes) would 0/0 -> NaN as in C; min.sz=5 makes this unreachable in practice.
upstream_audit: upstream_c/_extracted/GSVA/src/kernel_estimation.c (GSVA 1.50.5): Poisson kernel confirmed verbatim - bw = 0.5 (rnaseq), left_tail += ppois(y[j], x[i]+bw, TRUE, FALSE), r = -log((1-left_tail)/left_tail); SIGMA_FACTOR 4.0 for the Gaussian branch (not ported)

upstream_c/_extracted/GSVA/src/ks_test.c (GSVA 1.50.5): ks_sample verbatim - dec = 1/(n_genes - n_geneset); sum_gset = sum pow(x[gset], tau); walk over sort.sgn.idxs; hit: += pow(x,tau)/sum_gset; miss: -= dec; mx_diff: mx_pos+mx_neg (abs_rnk: mx_pos-mx_neg; else max form)

upstream_c/_extracted/GSVA/R/gsva.R + R/utils.R (GSVA 1.50.5): orchestration confirmed - kcdf->rnaseq/kernel mapping, .filterFeatures, .mapGeneSetsToFeatures, filterGeneSets, compute.geneset.es rank-score step, ks_test_m .Call chain

paper cross-validation (Hanzelmann/Castelo/Guinney 2013, BMC Bioinformatics 14:7): eq.(2) Poisson kernel F_r(x_ij) = (1/n) sum_k P(Pois(x_ik + r) <= x_ij) with r=0.5 == C source (bw=0.5, ppois(y_test, x_dens+0.5)) EXACT MATCH; eq.(3) walk weights |r_ij|^tau with r_ij = |p/2 - rank| == C compute_rank_score (highest-z gene weight p/2) EXACT MATCH; eq.(4)/(5) max-deviation vs difference options == C mx.diff FALSE/TRUE with eq.(5) reading ES+ - ES- where ES- is the magnitude (ES+ - |ES-| == C's mx_pos + mx_neg since mx_neg <= 0) - CONSISTENT under that reading; the C source is the operational authority for the sign convention (signed scores for bottom-enriched sets).
build_cmd: no build step; smoke: python smoke_test.py
smoke_details: 10/10 PASS: U2 _ppois_lower == naive Poisson CDF (2.0e-15) and == scipy.stats.poisson.cdf on integer q; U1 gene-density logit == C-source row_d naive transcription (<1e-12); U3 FULL pipeline == naive ks_sample transcription (0.00e+00 deviation) on 40 genes x 6 cells x 3 sets; U4 set filtering (min 5 / max 100 keeps UP/DOWN only), shape sets x cells all finite (no NaN), UP set enriched in boosted cells (0.521 > -0.693), random sets on random counts median ES 0.006 ~ 0, constant gene filtered without NaN; U5 ES within [-1,1].
